steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: NEA Task 2 is a food preparation assessment worth 35% of the total GCSE grade (AQA 8585). It is completed in controlled conditions over approximately 20 hours. | Key Fact: Task 2 requires students to plan, prepare, cook, and present a menu of three dishes (plus accompaniments) in response to a set brief, typically within a 3-hour practical session. | Key Fact: The brief specifies a context and target group, e.g. 'Plan and prepare a menu for a teenager following a vegetarian diet' or 'Produce a menu for a family on a low budget'. | Key Fact: Task 2 portfolio must include: research into the brief, analysis of the task, menu planning and justification, nutritional analysis, time plan, costings, practical skills evidence, and evaluation.

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice
steps.body: Full-Mark Response You have been set the following NEA Task 2 brief: 'Plan and prepare three dishes suitable for a vegetarian teenager, ensuring the menu is nutritionally balanced.'
